questions.chapter: Introduction, Types of Estimates & Units of Measurement
questions.text: Explain different types of Estimates: (a) Preliminary / Approximate Estimate (Plinth area method, Cubical content method, Unit base method), (b) Detailed Estimate, (c) Supplementary Estimate, (d) Revised Estimate, and (e) Annual Maintenance Estimate. State units of measurement and rules for deduction in brick masonry and plastering conforming to IS 1200.

questions.chapter: Quantity Estimation Methods (Long Wall-Short Wall & Center Line)
questions.text:
For a two-room residential building with room sizes $4.0\,\text{m} \times 5.0\,\text{m}$ and $4.0\,\text{m} \times 4.0\,\text{m}$ (wall thickness $300\,\text{mm}$), calculate the quantities of the following items using both: (a) Long Wall - Short Wall Method, and (b) Center Line Method:
1. Earthwork excavation in foundation trenches
2. Cement concrete 1:3:6 in foundation
3. Brickwork in foundation and plinth in cement mortar 1:4
4. Damp Proof Course (DPC) $25\,\text{mm}$ thick
5. Brickwork in superstructure in cement mortar 1:6.

questions.chapter: Rate Analysis & Standard Norms (DoR & DUDBC)
questions.text: What is Rate Analysis? Explain the factors affecting rate analysis (Cost of materials at source + carriage, labor wages, tools and plant, contractor's overhead and profit $15\%$, VAT). Prepare Rate Analysis for: (a) $1\,\text{m}^3$ of RCC 1:1.5:3 work in slabs/beams excluding reinforcement and formwork, and (b) $1\,\text{m}^3$ of brickwork in 1:4 cement mortar using Nepal government District Rates / DUDBC norms.

questions.chapter: Specifications Writing & Valuation of Real Properties
questions.text: What is Specification? Differentiate between General (Brief) Specifications and Detailed Specifications. Write detailed technical specifications for: (a) Earthwork in excavation in foundation, (b) Reinforced Cement Concrete (M20 grade), and (c) First class brickwork in cement mortar 1:4.

questions.chapter: Specifications Writing & Valuation of Real Properties
questions.text: Define Valuation, Market Value, Book Value, Salvage Value, Scrap Value, Sinking Fund, Year's Purchase ($YP = \frac{1}{i + s}$), and Capitalized Value. Calculate the Capitalized Value of a commercial property producing a gross annual rental income of $\text{NPR } 600,000$. Outgoings including taxes, repairs, and insurance are $20\%$ of gross rent. Rate of interest on capital is $8\%$ and sinking fund interest is $5\%$ for a remaining life of 40 years.

questions.chapter: Contracts, Tenders & Procurement Act (PPMO / FIDIC)
questions.text: Classify Engineering Contracts: Item Rate (Unit Price) Contract, Lump-Sum Contract, Cost Plus Percentage / Fixed Fee Contract, Turnkey / EPC Contract, and BOT / BOOT models. What are the essential elements of a valid contract according to the Nepal Public Procurement Act (PPA)?

questions.chapter: Contracts, Tenders & Procurement Act (PPMO / FIDIC)
questions.text: Explain the Tendering Process (Notice Inviting Tender - NIT, Pre-qualification, Tender documents, Earnest Money Deposit / Bid Security $2-3\%$, Performance Security $5\%$, Bid evaluation, Letter of Intent - LoI, Letter of Acceptance - LoA). What is Liquidated Damages and Retention Money?
